# Alert

A message that stays on the page with the content it is about.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Accessible first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Accessible first:** Errors and important notes that stay on the page.

- **Use it when:** People need to read a standing notice or how to recover, on this page, tied to what they are doing.
- **Not when:** A short confirmation that can go away by itself, or one notice for the whole site.

Instead:

- [Toast](./toast.md): Short, non-blocking, goes away.
- [Dialog](./dialog.md): Needs an answer before going on.
- Site banner: One full-width notice for the whole site.

## Why it works this way

Alert looks the way it does because of 5 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Alert, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Which outcome matters most?</b><code>outcomes.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Completion without errors</div><p>Completion without errors is the measure.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Alert</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Important notes that stay on the page while people answer.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: success</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Alert decision would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Links and actions</b>, <b>Form steps and errors</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-human-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What must the interface protect?</b><code>human.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Low effort to understand</div><p>Low effort to understand each step.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Alert</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Important notes that stay on the page while people answer.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Empty: default</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Alert decisions would reopen</small><p>and 15 answers that follow from it: <b>Calm and clear</b>, <b>Quiet</b>, <b>Core: heading, body, label</b>, and 12 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many signals carry each meaning?</b><code>accessibility.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Three: color, icon and word</div><p>Never color alone.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Alert</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>destructive</b>: Errors, with what went wrong, where, and exactly how to fix it, next to the field.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: neutral</code> <code>Badge: success</code> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Badge: danger</code> <code>Item: muted</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Alert decision would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Status and messages</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is a costly mistake?</b><code>outcomes.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">A task that fails</div><p>A failed form can cost someone a benefit.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Alert</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>destructive</b>: Errors, with what went wrong, where, and exactly how to fix it, next to the field.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: secondary</code> <code>Button: danger</code> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Badge: danger</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Alert decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] An error that appears after an action is announced (role alert); a standing note is not. undefined
- [ ] The tone also shows as an icon and words, never color alone. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add alert
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
